- Confirm with `pwd` and `git branch --show-current` that you are in your own isolated worktree, not .../oslo. If your branch has a generic name, run `git fetch origin && git switch -c ehewes/52-morning-briefing origin/main` first.
- `./hq setup` (bun install --frozen-lockfile). There is no .env; that is expected.
- `./hq claim 52 --agent claude`. If it refuses, stop and report why.
- Context, per .entire/agent-guide.md: `entire brain brief "<task>" --json`, then `entire graph query --repo . --profile full --head --format agent --max-context-bytes 4096 --query "<task>"`. Use Graph for later locate/relationship questions too.

Design (my recommendation; follow the code if it disagrees)
- `packages/shared/src/briefing/`: Zod schemas for `briefing.get` input `{ nightId }` and output `{ nightId, text, audioUrl: string | null }`, plus pure helpers if useful (facts from a night, text validation). Pure TS, no IO.
- `apps/server/src/features/briefing/service.ts`: `createBriefingService({ getNight, generateText, speak })`, defaults bound to `getNight` from `../night` (index.ts only), `generateJson` from integrations/gemini, `speak` from integrations/elevenlabs. Injected fakes in tests; no test touches the network.
- Facts for the prompt, from the night record: wake-up count and how many followed a spike, linked event labels with Europe/London HH:MM times, label counts, construction events outside the council's recommended hours with times. Drop every `handling` event before anything reaches the prompt or the fallback. Never put raw vitals in the prompt.
- Prompt carries the docs/DOMAIN.md wording rules: "followed"/"linked to", never "caused by"; "outside the council's recommended hours", never "illegal"/"breach"; no bare "dB"; at most 40 words; never mention handling or the phone moving.
- Validate every briefing: at most 40 words, `bannedWording(text)` from `@kip/shared/domain` empty, no handling mention. Retry Gemini once on a failed check, then fall back to a deterministic template built from the facts that passes the same checks. Test that a briefing with a Never-say phrase is rejected.
- Audio: ElevenLabs `speak(text)`, cached in memory (bounded Map) keyed by nightId plus a hash of the text. Serve `audio/mpeg` from a plain route in `features/briefing/http.ts` exported as `briefingHttp` from index.ts; 404 when not cached. If TTS fails, return the text with `audioUrl: null` and log only a fixed reason word.
- `briefing.get` (userProcedure): NOT_FOUND if the night is missing or `night.userId !== ctx.userId`.
- app.ts mounts plain routes and only has labels and works lines from M0. Add exactly `briefingHttp(app);` plus its import next to them. app.ts is not in the issue's Do not touch list and the AC needs the route served. Call out this one line in the PR's Risks. Do not edit integrations/, domain/, router.ts, main.*.ts, env.ts or other features; anything else needed there becomes a follow-up issue (hq-work skill, "Out of scope").
- Never log prompts, night data, briefing text or health values.

Finish (hq-work skill, .claude/skills/hq-work/SKILL.md)
- Small commits, files staged by name. Subject: imperative, says what the product can now do, under ~60 chars, no em dashes. AGENTS.md overrides the Co-Authored-By reminder: no AI or co-author trailers in commits. Keep any automatic Entire-Checkpoint trailer.
- `./hq check` must pass. Rebase on origin/main before the PR if not yet pushed (merge if already pushed), then re-run check.
- Write `.context/pr-52.md` in your worktree using the hq-work template (What changed, How verified with the tail of ./hq check, Risks including the app.ts line and the (keys) verify step left for a human, Screenshots n/a). End it with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)". Then `./hq pr 52 --agent claude --body-file .context/pr-52.md`.
- Trail: `entire trail show`, then `entire trail ci-pr`; create one only if show finds none.
- size:M, so run `entire review`, fix real findings, push, re-run check, then `gh pr edit <PR> --add-label review:pass` and `entire trail ready`.
- Stop. Never run `./hq ship` or merge.
